acceptanceCriteria.ac: Given I open the application When the app loads Then I see a navigation header with tabs: Dashboard | Data Entry | Compare | Track
Given the navigation is displayed When I view the header Then I see the app title "Flowline Finance Studio" with the logo
Given I click the "Dashboard" tab When navigation completes Then the Dashboard page placeholder is displayed
Given I click the "Data Entry" tab When navigation completes Then the Data Entry page placeholder is displayed
Given I click the "Compare" tab When navigation completes Then the Compare page placeholder is displayed
Given I click the "Track" tab When navigation completes Then the Track page placeholder is displayed
Given I am on any page When I view the navigation Then the current page tab has a teal underline indicator (#0d9488)
Given I am viewing on mobile (< 640px width) When I view the navigation Then the navigation collapses to a hamburger menu
Given I am on mobile and click the hamburger menu When the menu opens Then I see a drawer (Sheet component) with all navigation options listed vertically
Given I click a navigation item in the mobile drawer When navigation completes Then the drawer closes automatically and the selected page is displayed
Given I resize the browser When the width crosses the 640px breakpoint Then the layout adapts responsively (tabs on desktop, hamburger on mobile)
Given the pages are created When I view each placeholder page Then each page shows a centered heading with the page name

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Defines layout component structure: src/components/layout/ for Header.tsx, Navigation.tsx, PageContainer.tsx. Page components in src/pages/.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: FR53 (navigation) maps to components/layout/ and pages/. Dashboard as primary landing page (FR42).

doc.title: UX Design
doc.snippet: Navigation pattern: Top-level tabs (Dashboard | Data Entry | Compare | Track). Mobile: hamburger menu. Current page: teal underline indicator.

doc.title: UX Design
doc.snippet: Breakpoints: Mobile < 640px (sm), Tablet 640-1024px (md, lg), Desktop > 1024px. Mobile: navigation becomes hamburger menu.

doc.title: UX Design
doc.snippet: Primary: teal-600 (#0d9488) for active indicators. Primary Dark: teal-700 (#0f766e) for hover. Text: slate-900. Background: slate-50.

doc.title: UX Design
doc.snippet: Use shadcn/ui Tabs for section navigation, Sheet for mobile drawer. Customize with Balanced Teal theme.
